items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And Al Moore, a boy from here, played trombone.

ctx.x: How much would you get, say, at that? Oh, $35 a week was about a standard salary then. Who was with Caprero then?

Shorty Reese and Santobi, we were the sax team. And Al Moore, a boy from here, played trombone. And the two trumpet players were from a way out, I forget their names, one boy I remember was from Philadelphia. And well we were just about the only local boy, New Orleans boys, about four of us in a town. This old man Grosso was a concertmaster for Metropolitan for about eight, ten years. He really was a fine musician.
